summary: Rotation day. Picks lean on names whose relative trend held through the rotation.

pick.thesis: Costco has outpaced the benchmark across the lookback window with a steady, orderly advance. Trend and relative strength agree, and no active lesson argues against this setup.
risks: Momentum reversal after an extended run
pick.invalidation: A close back below the recent range low while the benchmark holds firm.
